item.title: UPDATE: Michigan Man Dies in Marshall County Crash
item.description: Christopher J. Jankoviak, 57, Niles, Mich., died in a two-vehicle crash at US 31 and SR 10, Argos.

item.title: Bobcat Hunting Season Quickly Hits Limit
item.description: The Indiana Department of Natural Resources has closed the bobcat trapping season after reaching the statewide quota of 250 bobcats in just four weeks.

item.title: Barbarshop Quartets To Sing Christmas Songs At Dutchtown Bible Church
item.description: Dutchtown Bible Church will hold a special Christmas musical program featuring two barbershop quartets.

item.title: Starke County Moves Forward With Data Center Moratorium Proposal
item.description: Starke County could soon join a growing list of Indiana counties moving to temporarily halt large scale data center development after its planning commission advanced a proposed one year moratorium.

item.title: Warsaw City Offices To close Briefly Thursday
item.description: City of Warsaw Offices will close between 11:30 a.m. and 1:30 p.m. Thursday, Dec. 11, to 1:30 p.m. to allow all employees to attend a holiday lunch celebration.

item.title: Winter WonderLab at Science Central
item.description: Join Science Central from 5-7 p.m. Thursday, Friday and Saturday, Dec. 18, 19 and 20 for its new Winter WonderLab event, celebrating STEAM, winter and the holiday season.

item.title: Appeals Court Blocks Indiana Release Of Abortion Records
item.description: The Indiana Court of Appeals has upheld an order blocking the release of terminated pregnancy reports by the Indiana Department of Health, ruling that the documents are protected as confidential patient medical records under state law.

item.title: Leesburg Council Approves 2026 Salary Increase For Non-Elected Officials
item.description: At the final Leesburg Town Council meeting of the year held Monday, Dec. 8, council voted to officially approve a 2% increase for non-elected town officials for 2026.
